newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis values sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis values sharply lower.

text.p: FOB Gulf basis values for corn continued to slide, down 29 to 44 cents per bushel for September positions, in reaction to weak export demand and a sharp decline in CIF basis values, grain dealers said.

Also, weighing on values is new-crop corn from the southeast U.S. entering market channels. Interior basis bids dropped sharply since Monday as Midwest processors were able to fill immediate needs by shipping in corn from south by rail or barge.
Soybean values were slightly firmer, while winter wheat values were unchanged.
Dealers quoted the following afternoon FOB U.S. Gulf values, basis Chicago futures, except hard red winter wheat basis Kansas City. (In cents per bushel).
